description: Compares equal periods before and after a date, such as a site change or a Google update: totals, devices, and the pages and queries that moved, Google Analytics sessions from the property whose web stream matches the site, and Google updates in the window. Optional pages narrows it to URLs that contain that text, such as /blog/.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the first day after the change.

site.description: Search Console property or site, such as sc-domain:example.com, https://example.com/ or example.com.

name: seo_compare
title: Before and after a date
